aboutText: With over 20 years of experience, DeckSeal has been the go-to team for deck restoration in Point Cook. Our skilled professionals specialise in bringing tired decks back to life, using high-quality materials and techniques. We are committed to exceptional service and transforming outdoor spaces across the suburb and beyond.
servicesText: We offer a complete range of deck services, from initial restoration to regular maintenance. Our team ensures your deck is cleaned, sanded, stained, and oiled to the highest standard, keeping it looking beautiful and protected.

services.title: Deck Restoration & Repair
services.desc: We restore damaged or worn decks to their former glory, including structural repairs and surface renewal.

services.title: Deck Cleaning & Pressure Washing
services.desc: Professional cleaning and high-pressure washing to remove dirt, grime, and mildew from your deck.

services.title: Deck Sanding & Preparation
services.desc: Expert sanding to smooth surfaces and prepare for staining or painting, ensuring a flawless finish.

services.title: Deck Staining & Oiling
services.desc: Application of high-quality stains and oils to enhance colour and protect against the elements.

services.title: Composite Deck Maintenance
services.desc: Specialised care for composite decking materials to maintain their appearance and longevity.

services.title: Paving & Concrete Cleaning
services.desc: Cleaning and restoration of paving and concrete areas around your deck for a complete outdoor makeover.
